notes.title: The big sexy UP date
notes.content:

[list]
[*] New Female Bodies
[*] New  Male Bodies
[*] New Female Heads
[*] New Male Heads
[*] New Sunglasses
[*] New Hairstyles and Hats
[/list]
We also added[b] LEADERBOARDS[/b] so players can see who the world's biggest Flirt is and for a bit of a challenge, we  added some unlockable[b] ACHIEVEMENTS[/b] that you can earn if you play your cards right.

Good luck getting lucky.
